Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Bănci și Servicii financiare
Company Description 
 Founded by two engineers, Swissquote makes trading opportunities accessible to everyone and we challenge everything that makes traditional banking irrelevant.
 The Swissquote Tech Hub in Bucharest is meant to create a new high-calibre location for the Swissquote engineering group. The Tech Hub is structured around the design, build and maintenance of innovative and reliable systems, products and services. Operating within a collaborative Agile environment, we aim to deliver effective solutions to the business and our customers using our evolving platforms.
 Key Responsibilities 
Design, develop, test, and maintain backend services supporting trading-related applications.
Develop and maintain REST APIs and contribute to integrations with internal and external systems, including industry protocols such as FIX, where applicable.
Participate in requirements clarification, technical discussions, grooming, and solution design, collaborating with engineers and stakeholders across teams.
Write clean, maintainable, and well-tested code following engineering best practices.
Participate in code reviews and provide constructive feedback.
Investigate application issues and support production systems, contributing to incident resolution when required.
Contribute to improving technical documentation, testing practices, and observability.
Use AI-assisted development tools responsibly to improve development efficiency.
 Technical Skills & Experience 
 Required 
Strong professional experience in backend development using Java and its ecosystem , at least 4 years .
Good understanding of object-oriented programming, clean code principles, and common software design patterns.
Experience with Spring / Spring Boot or similar Java frameworks.
Experience designing and developing REST APIs and service-to-service integrations.
Good understanding of distributed systems and communication between multiple services.
Good knowledge of SQL and relational databases.
Understanding of transaction management , error handling , retries , and application resilience .
Basic to good understanding of concurrency and multithreading concepts.
Experience with automated testing, including unit and integration testing.
Experience with version control, pull requests, code reviews, and CI/CD practices.
Ability to investigate application issues using logs, metrics, and other diagnostic information.
Ability to work independently, clarify requirements, evaluate implementation options, and take ownership of technical tasks.
 Nice to Have 
Previous experience in financial services , brokerage , trading platforms , or capital markets .
Knowledge of the FIX protocol or electronic trading workflows.
Experience with Kafka or other asynchronous messaging technologies.
Experience with event-driven architectures.
Experience with containerized applications and platforms such as Docker or Kubernetes.
Experience working on high-availability or business-critical systems.
Familiarity with performance analysis and application profiling.
 AI-Assisted Engineering 
 We encourage the responsible use of AI tools to support coding, debugging, testing, and documentation. Candidates should be able to critically evaluate AI-generated output and validate its correctness, security, and maintainability before using it in production. Familiarity with GitHub Copilot or similar tools is a plus.
 Engineering Mindset 
 We expect a Mid-level Engineer to demonstrate ownership, sound technical judgment, and problem-solving skills. You should be able to understand requirements, ask relevant questions, identify risks and dependencies, evaluate implementation options, and take responsibility for code quality and technical decisions.
 Collaboration Expectations 
 You should communicate effectively, contribute to technical discussions, code reviews, planning, and incident analysis, and collaborate constructively with colleagues and stakeholders. We value knowledge sharing, openness to feedback, and proactive communication of risks or blockers.
 Additional Information
 What we offer: 
Modern, international work environment built on collaboration, flexibility and respect
Hybrid way of working (1 day per week in the office)
Exciting opportunity to boost your career and develop solid banking and Fintech business expertise
25+ annual days off
Annual bonus
Medical insurance
Meal tickets
Shares plan
Bookster
